commit.message:
Add podLabels configuration to values.yaml and update deployment template to include pod labels (#54)

- Introduced a new `podLabels` property in `values.yaml` to allow users to specify custom labels for the Sawmills collector pods.
- Updated the `deployment.yaml` template to incorporate the new `podLabels` configuration, ensuring that these labels are applied to the pod template metadata.

This enhancement improves the flexibility of the Helm chart by allowing users to customize pod labels as needed.
